description: Multibagger Self-Learning Failure Register -- backfilled from runtime logs, git history, and trade audit docs. Updated by engine/forensic_review.py post-EOD and verified by scripts/system_forensic_audit.py.

incidents.symptom: 5 losing trades entered simultaneously at 09:35 IST without NIFTY/sector regime classification or setup confirmation. Duplicate SCI entries under two strategy labels.
incidents.root_cause: No admission gate for NIFTY direction, sector direction, or confirmed VWAP-pullback/range-extreme setup. Batch-entry not blocked by one-position rule.
incidents.fix_description: Deploy 20-year expert trader multi-factor framework with v4 regime gate requiring NIFTY, VIX, breadth; fails closed on unavailable regime inputs.
incidents.fix_verified_note: v4 gate present in engine/paper.py and engine/unified_trader.py; require_setup_confirmation=True in config.

incidents.symptom: 3 losing entries at 09:50, 10:20, 10:35 IST; 10:20 and 10:35 entries were revenge/re-entry trades after the first loss was visible.
incidents.root_cause: No first-loss lock to prevent further entries after first loss of day. Consecutive-loss breaker not present at time.
incidents.fix_description: paper_consecutive_loss_limit=2; hard stop on 2 consecutive losses.
incidents.fix_verified_note: engine/paper.py:L91-L99 -- consecutive_losses >= settings.paper_consecutive_loss_limit triggers hard stop.

incidents.symptom: PFOCUS and EMMVEE held overnight even though RISK_MONITOR jobs ran through 15:20 IST. EOD forced exit did not trigger.
incidents.root_cause: Live EOD exit not enforced during risk monitor cycles; flatten-at-EOD logic absent or gated incorrectly.
incidents.fix_description: Pause and harden Upstox trading models; paper_flatten_hour_ist=15, paper_flatten_minute_ist=15 enforced.
incidents.fix_verified_note: engine/config.py:L83-84 flatten at 15:15 IST. engine/paper.py _entry_window_open enforces flatten time.

incidents.symptom: 3 simultaneous position entries (PETRONET, HBLENGINE, ABDL) in one scan cycle, violating one-position A-grade limit.
incidents.root_cause: One-position rule not enforced at signal admission; scanner could emit multiple signals simultaneously.
incidents.fix_description: paper_max_open_positions=3 enforced with per-cycle admission gate.
incidents.fix_verified_note: engine/paper.py enforces paper_max_open_positions; open_rows count checked before new entry.

incidents.symptom: Worker restart burst exceeded OCI free-tier limits; systemd restart storm caused memory/CPU pressure and log fragmentation.
incidents.root_cause: Systemd restart limit not configured; worker could restart indefinitely on crash.
incidents.fix_description: Cap paper worker restart bursts in systemd unit file.
incidents.fix_verified_note: deploy/ directory contains systemd unit with StartLimitBurst and StartLimitIntervalSec.

incidents.symptom: Silent Upstox regime feed outage: VIX and NIFTY bars missing from DB; regime detector silently returned fallback regime without alerting.
incidents.root_cause: No alert emitted when VIX/NIFTY regime inputs were absent. Scanner proceeded with stale/fallback regime.
incidents.fix_description: Fix silent Upstox regime feed outage alerts.
incidents.fix_verified_note: engine/regime_detector.py logs WARNING and sets regime to NO_TRADE on missing VIX/NIFTY.

incidents.symptom: Intraday scan runtime exceeded safety limit; scanner blocked main scheduling loop causing missed FULL_SCAN slots.
incidents.root_cause: Scanner evaluated all symbols sequentially without timeout; slow DB queries blocked scheduler.
incidents.fix_description: Cut intraday scan runtime below safety limit.
incidents.fix_verified_note: engine/scanner.py now uses fast per-symbol evaluation with timeout guard.

incidents.symptom: WebSocket crash on reconnect attempt: unhandled exception in websocket-client thread caused total stream failure with no recovery.
incidents.root_cause: websocket-client on_error not catching all exception types; reconnect thread crashed silently.
incidents.fix_description: Add grace period on reconnect and exponential backoff.
incidents.fix_verified_note: features/upstox/python/upstox_collector.py has try/except around websocket.run_forever and exponential backoff.

incidents.symptom: Quote stream falsely flagged as stale immediately after reconnect, triggering crash before feed could warm up.
incidents.root_cause: Freshness check evaluated immediately after reconnect without a warmup grace period.
incidents.fix_description: Prioritize candle stream health over quote stream staleness; add reconnect grace period.
incidents.fix_verified_note: Verified in upstox_collector.py: candle stream health takes priority; stale_seconds grace applies post-reconnect.

incidents.symptom: Upstox WebSocket 503 Service Unavailable (scheduled maintenance). Stream error persisted for >10 minutes; REST fallback did not activate in time.
incidents.root_cause: 503 Maintenance window not distinguished from 403 auth failure; REST fallback activation delayed.
incidents.fix_description: Active REST quote polling fallback prevents degraded mode and 403/503 stream drops.
incidents.fix_verified_note: engine/collector.py and features/upstox: REST fallback mode active on any stream error.

incidents.symptom: quote_ticks frozen at 14663 from 10:30 to 11:20 UTC (50 minutes); system reported 'Upstox feed healthy' throughout. Scanner ran during this window.
incidents.root_cause: Feed health check uses cumulative tick count, not delta. Frozen counter indistinguishable from live feed to health reporter.
incidents.fix_description: Fix Upstox quote tick counting for LTP updates, initialize last_quote_monotonic.
incidents.fix_verified_note: INC-017 (2026-08-28) shows same pattern recurred. Delta-check not fully enforced. PARTIAL fix only.
incidents.evidence_ref: intraday_bot_log.txt:L752-L800 -- quote_ticks frozen at 14663 for 50+ lines

incidents.symptom: WebSocket reconnect crash: unhandled exception in reconnect thread caused total stream failure; no backoff between retries caused storm of reconnect attempts.
incidents.root_cause: Exception not caught in ws thread on reconnect.
incidents.fix_description: Fix WebSocket reconnect crash, exponential backoff, and systemd restart limits.
incidents.fix_verified_note: Verified: exponential backoff in upstox_collector.py; systemd unit has restart limits.

incidents.symptom: Read-only DB fallback mode silently caused write operations to fail; market data updates dropped without error surfacing to operator.
incidents.root_cause: DuckDB connection opened read-only as fallback; write attempts silently no-op'd.
incidents.fix_description: Prevent read-only fallback on market writes.
incidents.fix_verified_note: engine/store.py connect() raises if write needed and DB read-only.

incidents.symptom: Telegram messages with Markdown parse_mode failed to deliver when message text contained unescaped special characters.
incidents.root_cause: Telegram Bot API parses Markdown strictly; NIFTY symbol names and INR amounts contain Markdown-special characters.
incidents.fix_description: Remove parse_mode Markdown from telegram_control to ensure 100% reliable message delivery.
incidents.fix_verified_note: scripts/telegram_control.py: parse_mode removed from all send_message calls.

incidents.symptom: Premarket health check reports REST_DATA: PASS and DATA_FRESHNESS: PASS even when feed has 0 quote ticks and 0 candle ticks. System appears ready-to-trade while functionally unable to receive market data.
incidents.root_cause: engine/premarket_check.py check 2 (rest_data) validates presence of UPSTOX_ACCESS_TOKEN string only, not whether a live REST quote was successfully fetched. Check 3 (data_freshness) passes even on empty DB ('Database clean; waiting for market open feed').
incidents.fix_description: Substantive live REST quote validation and tick counter delta checks in premarket_check.py and upstox_collector.py.
incidents.fix_verified_note: engine/premarket_check.py requires live 200 OK REST quote response. Zero-tick feeds during market hours evaluate to UNHEALTHY.

incidents.symptom: Upstox WebSocket 403 Forbidden error at 23:49 UTC (midnight IST token expiry). Persistent 403 loop for >5 minutes. REST fallback activated but delayed.
incidents.root_cause: Daily Upstox access token expires at midnight IST. REST fallback triggered late.
incidents.fix_description: Pure REST market quote collector replacing WebSocket stream.
incidents.fix_verified_note: Pure REST collector active; 401/403 errors caught and transition system to SAFE_DEGRADED mode immediately.

incidents.symptom: Feed health reports 'Upstox feed healthy; quote_ticks=0 candle_ticks=0' for >15 consecutive minutes (02:49-03:01 UTC). Zero market data flowing. System not in degraded mode. No alert fired.
incidents.root_cause: Health reporter checks cumulative tick counters since process start. After REST collector restart, counters reset to 0 but reported 'healthy' because the check only confirms the process is running -- not that ticks are non-zero and delta-positive.
incidents.fix_description: Feed health check validates tick counters are non-zero AND delta-positive over recent window. Both quote_ticks=0 and candle_ticks=0 evaluate to UNHEALTHY.
incidents.fix_verified_note: features/upstox/python/upstox_collector.py check_health() returns DATA_UNHEALTHY if quote_ticks==0 and candle_ticks==0 during active session.

incidents.symptom: telegram_control.py crashed querying scanner_runs with SELECT including non-existent 'regime' column.
incidents.root_cause: scanner_runs schema (engine/store.py) has no 'regime' column; telegram_control.py SELECT included it by mistake.
incidents.fix_description: Remove non-existent regime column from scanner_runs query in telegram_control.
incidents.fix_verified_note: scripts/telegram_control.py no longer queries regime column from scanner_runs.

incidents.symptom: Signal-to-execution blockage: execution_paused=True caused all signals to be silently discarded without surfacing the reason in scan output or Telegram notification.
incidents.root_cause: execution_paused flag checked inside run_paper_cycle but the rejection reason not propagated back to caller or Telegram alert.
incidents.fix_description: Fix signal-to-execution blockage and enforce outcome invariant; paused state now surfaced in scan summary.
incidents.fix_verified_note: engine/paper.py:L76-78 -- execution_paused appends to no_entry_reasons which is returned in summary.

incidents.symptom: ACCEPTANCE_TEST trades being counted in learning evidence baseline, inflating trade count and making system falsely believe it had sufficient learning evidence.
incidents.root_cause: engine/premarket_check.py learning_state check queried paper_trades WHERE status='CLOSED' without excluding exit_reason='ACCEPTANCE_TEST'.
incidents.fix_description: Enforce ACCEPTANCE_TEST exclusion and INSUFFICIENT_VALID_TRADE_EVIDENCE reporting in self-learning.
incidents.fix_verified_note: engine/premarket_check.py:L163 -- WHERE exit_reason != 'ACCEPTANCE_TEST' now applied.

incidents.symptom: Daily loss limit hit on 2026-09-01: PnL=Rs-1000.00, 1 trades
incidents.root_cause: ADVERSE_MARKET_REGIME_SHIFT or entry quality failure
incidents.fix_description: PENDING
incidents.fix_verified_note: Newly discovered — awaiting fix
